title: xolantha glomerata
intro: Xolantha glomerata, commonly known as  'Clustered Xolantha', is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, also referred to as the daisy or sunflower family. It is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Xolantha glomerata include its ability to act as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Xolantha glomerata include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
